_what: The four identifiers this project asks to be cited by. They are the four that outbound letters already use, which is the point: a link we send and a link we promise to keep must be the same link.
_rule: Every target here must resolve inside this repository: a path must exist, and a fragment must land on an element that carries that id. Enforced by check N; the same test check I applies to the weekly feed's own URLs, for the same reason -- exists is not arrives.
_promise: These four do not move. If one has to move, the old location keeps a pointer rather than disappearing, and the move is recorded in the error archive if anything published had already cited it.

links.what: the instrument's own failure archive -- the entry point this project leads with
the criteria, their three exit codes, and what each one does not establish
a number handed over under a deadline, with its limits and its own expiry attached
the machine-readable weekly issue; latest.json is the subscribed URL
